gaps.quote: effective mitigations of these emerging threats are currently lacking
studying black-box and grey-box attacks is also crucial for a more comprehensive evaluation

gap_notes: Both papers leave open how to defend against indirect prompt injection: the first finds effective mitigations lacking and calls for evaluating deception potential with user studies; the second breaks eight defenses with white-box adaptive attacks and calls for black-box and grey-box attacks and for testing combined defenses.
